theater: 夏州朔方城與河套東緣

battle.name: 梁師都起事
battle.theater: 夏州朔方城與河套東緣
battle.brief: 大業十一年（617），夏州朔方豪族梁師都聚徒殺郡丞，據郡稱大丞相，旋僭號梁國皇帝、建元永隆，北連突厥。隋亡後他與劉武周並立，屢引突厥兵寇延州，武德二年野豬嶺為段德操所大破，貞觀二年終為從弟洛仁所斬。卡面羅馬標槍早一千七百年，不在此戰場；可對照者為隋唐邊軍的短投槍、臂弩與拒馬。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場起事的一端是隋朝、隨後是唐朝的西北邊軍體系，另一端是梁師都本部與其背後的東突厥汗庭。隋末的朔方郡（今陝西靖邊一帶）是邊防重鎮，除郡兵之外還有鷹揚府、屯田與馬政的編制；郡丞唐宗被殺之後，隋廷先遣將領張世隆討之，反為所敗，此後地方防務實際上落空。唐朝接手後，討伐的主力是邊鎮的正式編制：延州總管段德操、副總管梁禮領邊兵與郡兵作戰；夏州長史劉旻、司馬劉蘭以勁卒直據朔方東城，負責經略與策反；貞觀二年則由右衛大將軍柴紹、殿中少監薛萬均率京師禁軍入援，節制沿邊州縣的兵與糧。起事方沒有常備國家，只有梁師都結集的徒黨數千人與本郡豪族武力：他先以大丞相號聚眾，殺郡丞、據郡城，再分兵略雕陰、弘化、延安三郡，兵源來自邊郡逃卒、屯田民戶與內附的稽胡部眾，器械靠劫掠州縣倉廩與自鑄，糧秣靠就地取糧與掠取屯糧。外援方面，東突厥自始畢可汗起即介入，授師都狼頭纛、號大度毗伽可汗，助其拔鹽川郡、屯兵河南之地，後來處羅可汗、頗利可汗又以萬騎援之，雙方實為主從式的聯盟。同期北方還有劉武周、竇建德、薛舉等割據者，彼此曾商議合兵，卻無統一指揮，各為政權，各自為戰。
countriesEn: The two sides of this rising were the frontier military system of the Sui, and after 618 that of the Tang, and on the other hand the troops of Liang Shidu together with the Eastern Turkic khaganate that stood behind him. Shuofang commandery in the late Sui, in what is now the Jingbian area of Shaanxi, was a major frontier garrison: besides the county levies it carried the establishments of the eagle-flight office, of the garrison farms and of the horse administration. After the district governor Tang Zong was killed, the court first sent General Zhang Shilong against the rebels and he was defeated instead, after which the defence of the district was for practical purposes gone. Under the Tang the force that carried the war was the regular establishment of the border towns: the Chief Commissioner of Yan Prefecture, Duan Deco, with Deputy Commissioner Liang Li, led the frontier soldiers and the county levies; the Chief Administrator of Xia Prefecture, Liu Min, and his military clerk Liu Lan took picked troops straight to occupy the eastern city of Shuofang and were responsible for the reduction and the subornation of the enemy; and in the second year of Zhenguan the Right Guard Commander-in-chief Chai Shao and the Palace Attendant Xue Wanjun led capital guards into the field and took charge of the troops and the grain of the border prefectures. The insurgents had no state at all: only the several thousand men Liang Shidu gathered in his own district and the private retainers of the local great families. He first rallied them under the title of Grand Chancellor, killed the district governor and seized the city, then sent columns to take the neighbouring districts of Diaoyin, Honghua and Yan'an; his men came from deserters of the frontier districts, from farm households and from submitted Hu tribes, his weapons from plundered county storehouses and his own smiths, his grain from the country round about and from seized garrison stores. On the outside, the Eastern Turks were in from the first months under Qimin Khagan, who sent Liang Shidu a wolf-head standard and the title of Grand Tudu Biga Khagan, helped him take the district of Yanchuan and to station troops on the southern bank of the Yellow River, and was later joined by Quluguo and by Jieli Khagan with ten thousand riders. The alliance was in effect one of master and servant. In the north at the same time stood Liu Wuzhou, Dou Jiande, Xue Ju and other separatists, who discussed a joint campaign among themselves but never accepted a single command: each was a regime of his own and fought his own wars.
people: 梁師都是夏州朔方的郡豪，本郡大族，仕隋鷹揚郎將，邊軍武職出身。大業末他罷歸鄉里，陰結徒黨數千人，一夕殺死郡丞唐宗、據郡反，自稱大丞相；打敗隋將張世隆之後，他遣兵略定雕陰、弘化、延安三郡，遂僭即皇帝位，祭天於城南，掘地得印以為瑞兆，稱梁國，建元永隆。突厥始畢可汗遣他狼頭纛，號大度毗伽可汗。師都多猜忌：他收留內附的稽胡大帥劉仚成，聽讒將其殺死，部眾因此多懷疑而叛；兵勢窘迫時他索性往朝頗利可汗，替突厥籌劃南下入寇，渭橋之役亦出其意。他拒人千里，卻不恤部曲性命，終為自己人所斬。官軍一方，延州總管段德操是此役的主要戰將：他不與師都急戰，按甲以挫其銳，待其氣懈，遣副總管梁禮出戰，自己以輕騎出其不意，一戰逐北二百餘里，數月後再以步騎五千來犯的師都又被擊潰，俘斬略盡。貞觀二年奉詔討師都的是柴紹與薛萬均；負責長期困局的是夏州長史劉旻與司馬劉蘭，他們把俘獲的生口縱回去做反間，又頻遣輕騎踐踏禾稼，斷其田禾。終局由師都的從父弟梁洛仁動手，一劍斬之出降，被授右驍衛將軍、封朔方郡公。另有尚書陸季覽奉命遊說處羅可汗，謀四路大舉南下，是師都方面的關鍵外交人物。
peopleEn: Liang Shidu was a great family of Shuofang in Xia Prefecture, born into the local elite and trained as a frontier officer: he had served the Sui as a Langjiang of the Yingyang office, an appointment in the border army. At the end of the Daye era he was dismissed and returned to his home district, and there he quietly gathered several thousand followers. In a single night they killed the district governor Tang Zong and seized the city, and he proclaimed himself Grand Chancellor; after defeating the Sui general Zhang Shilong he sent columns to take the districts of Diaoyin, Honghua and Yan'an, and then assumed the imperial title, sacrificed to Heaven south of the city, and dug up a buried seal which he took as an auspicious sign, calling his state Liang and announcing the era Yonglong. Qimin Khagan sent him a wolf-head standard and named him Grand Tudu Biga Khagan. Shidu was a jealous man: he took in the submitted Hu chieftain Liu Yancheng, believed the slander told against him and had him killed, and his followers were thereafter full of suspicion and began to desert in numbers; when his position grew desperate he went in person to the court of Jieli Khagan and planned the Turkic invasion of the south for them, and the raid on the Wei River bridge was likewise his design. He kept everyone at a distance yet never cared for the lives of his own followers, and in the end he was killed by one of them. On the government side the principal commander was Duan Deco, Chief Commissioner of Yan Prefecture. He refused to engage in a hurry, held his troops under arms to dull the enemy's edge and waited until their vigour had slipped, then sent Deputy Commissioner Liang Li forward while he rode out with the light cavalry on their flank; the rout that followed was chased for more than two hundred li, and when Shidu came back with five thousand foot and horse a few months later he was broken again and his men were cut up almost to the last. Those sent against him in the second year of Zhenguan were Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun, while the long siege was run by Liu Min and Liu Lan, who sent the prisoners they had taken back to the enemy to work as agents and rode light cavalry out again and again over the standing crops to strip the fields. The last blow was struck by Liang Shidu's cousin on his father's side, Liang Luoren, who cut him down and came out to surrender; he was granted the rank of Right Cavalry Guard General and the title of Duke of Shuofang. The Minister Lu Jilan, who was sent to sound out Quluguo Khagan over a four-column invasion of the south, was the key diplomatic figure on Shidu's side.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬標槍（pilum）並不在夏州與延州的戰場上，它是技術母型，不是本役的實配。標槍是羅馬步兵的標準投射兵器：硬木長桿，前端套一段約半米長的錐形軟鐵槍芯，槍芯與木桿的接合處做成空腔。卡片所說的「捅穿盾之後就折斷」，說的是槍芯的軟鐵特性：它穿透盾牌之後會彎折甚至斷裂，盾牌兵只能帶著插在盾上的半截鐵芯退回掩體，一時無法再把盾舉成有效的防護，羅馬人正是靠這點在迦太基戰爭中壓住方陣前排。與之相比，隋唐邊軍在河套東緣真正使用的是短投槍（標槍）、步弓與臂弩、弩機、環首刀、長槊、木製手版與傍牌、明光甲與鎧甲，以及大量馬匹；攻城方向則有撞車、雲梯、巢車、飛石與投石機，拒馬與鹿角用於堵塞缺口，火箭與火牛用於燒毀浮橋與城樓。師都一方的核心是騎兵：突厥兵自帶健馬，憑弓矢與馬速衝撞唐軍的步兵線與採買隊伍，糧秣靠劫掠屯田與州縣倉廩維持。兩套武器系統的分界很清楚：羅馬標槍要解決的是密集重裝步兵的正面防護，唐軍與師都面對的卻是騎兵衝擊與守城器械；只有在「用一次性投射兵器毀掉成排防護」這一點上，兩套體系可以互相比照。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card was never present on the battlefield of Xia Prefecture or of Yan Prefecture: it is a technical archetype, not an issue of this campaign. The pilum was the standard missile of the Roman infantry, a long shaft of hardwood with a tapered soft-iron shank about half a metre long fixed to its front, the joint between shank and shaft being left hollow. What the card says, that it breaks after piercing a shield, is a statement about the soft iron of the shank: once driven through a shield it bends or snaps, and the shield bearer can only carry off half the iron still stuck in the shield and fall back behind cover, unable for a while to raise the shield as effective protection again. This is precisely how the Romans broke the front ranks of the phalanx in the wars against Carthage. The equipment actually used by the Sui and Tang frontier forces on the eastern edge of the Ordos bend was of another kind: short javelins, the foot bow and the arming crossbow, the mounted crossbow, the ring-pommel sabre, the long spear, wooden hand shields and side shields, the bright-faced armour and the lamellar harness, and a great many horses. On the side of siege they had the ram, the scaling ladder, the siege tower, the stone-thrower and the flying stone, with chevaux-de-frise and antler obstacles to block the breaches, and fire arrows and fire oxen to burn bridges and gate towers. The core of Shidu's side was the cavalry: the Turkic soldiers brought their own fast horses and used bow and speed to charge the Tang foot line and the provisioning parties, while their grain was maintained by raiding the garrison farms and the county storehouses. The division between the two systems of armament is plain. The Roman pilum was built to break the frontal protection of densely packed, heavily armoured infantry; what the Tang army and Shidu faced was cavalry charging and the problem of taking a walled town. The only point at which the two can be compared is the destruction of a formed screen of protection by a single expendable missile.
tactics: 起事與討伐的戰法，兩邊完全不同。梁師都用的是鄉里武裝起事的老套路：陰結徒黨、乘夜襲取郡城、一擊而奪政權，事後靠掠地擴張——先取本郡，再分兵略鄰郡雕陰、弘化、延安，把三郡的倉廩與丁口併入自己的兵源與糧源。兵力的骨幹是騎兵，起義初期靠劫來的馬與突厥的接應，在晉北與河套之間遊走，官軍一到即散為游騎，官軍一走即重新聚合；隋將張世隆的失敗正在於輕進。官軍這邊是標準的邊防戰法。段德操面對師都與突厥的數千騎，選擇按甲不戰，任其來銳氣自耗，待其氣懈，方遣梁禮率眾擊之，自己以輕騎出其不意掩至陣後，一戰而大潰，逐北二百餘里；數月後師都步騎五千再來寇，又被擊潰。劉武周覆亡後，師都遣尚書陸季覽說處羅可汗，謀四路大舉：莫賀咄設自原州入，泥步設與師都自延州入，處羅自並州入，突利可汗與奚、靺鞨、契丹自幽州入，再與竇建德會於滏口、晉絳——若成，則唐之北方與中原同時受敵，隋末的割據格局可能整體倒向聯軍。處羅病死，兵未出而計已廢。貞觀元年間，唐廷改用困局之法：以書喻降不聽，便縱俘獲的生口回去反間君臣，又頻遣輕騎出其不意專踐禾稼，斷其田禾，使城中糧盡而人心自散；歸附者一律善遇，使城中猜忌愈深。名將辛獠兒、李正寶曾圖謀執師都，事洩不成，李正寶乾脆降唐。貞觀二年，劉旻、劉蘭率勁卒直據朔方東城，柴紹、薛萬均合兵進屯城下，頗利可汗的援軍適逢大雪，羊馬凍死，柴紹逆擊破之，援兵不成，圍城遂成。終結這場僵局的不是攻城器械，而是內部的崩解：從父弟洛仁乘亂斬師都出降。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought by entirely different methods. Liang Shidu used the old pattern of a local rising: gather followers in secret, take the district city by a night attack, take power in a single stroke, and then expand by raiding the country. He took his own district first, then sent columns against the neighbouring districts of Diaoyin, Honghua and Yan'an, folding the storehouses and the households of those three districts into his own manpower and grain. The backbone of his force was cavalry: in the early months he relied on horses taken by raid and on Turkic support, moving between northern Shanxi and the Ordos bend, scattering into loose bands of riders when the government troops appeared and reforming when they withdrew. The defeat of the Sui general Zhang Shilong came precisely from advancing too lightly. On the government side the method was the standard defence of the frontier. Facing several thousand of Shidu's and Turkic riders, Duan Deco chose not to fight: he kept his men under arms and let the enemy's edge dull itself, and only when their vigour had slackened did he send Liang Li forward while he himself rode out with the light cavalry and fell on their flank, which produced a rout chased for more than two hundred li; a few months later Shidu came again with five thousand foot and horse and was broken a second time. After the fall of Liu Wuzhou, Shidu sent his Minister Lu Jilan to Quluguo Khagan to propose a four-column invasion: Mohe Dushe entering by Yuan prefecture, Nibushe and Shidu by Yan Prefecture, Quluguo by Bing Prefecture, and Tuli Khagan with the Xi, the Jilemang and the Khitan by You Prefecture, to join Dou Jiande at Fukou and at Jin and Jiang. Had it come off, the north and the central plain of the Tang would have been attacked at once and the whole balance of the separatist states might have turned. Quluguo died, the troops never marched, and the plan died with him. From the first year of Zhenguan the court changed to a war of attrition: when the letter of persuasion was refused, the prisoners in hand were sent back to work as agents between the ruler and his commanders, and light cavalry rode out again and again to trample the standing crops and cut the fields, so that the city grew hungry and the people within it lost heart; those who came in were treated well, which deepened the mutual suspicion inside the walls. The famous commanders Xin Liaor and Li Zhengbao once plotted to seize Shidu himself; the plot was uncovered and failed, and Li Zhengbao then went over to the Tang. In the second year of Zhenguan Liu Min and Liu Lan took picked troops straight to the eastern city of Shuofang, Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun joined forces and camped below the walls, and the relief army of Jieli Khagan met a heavy snow in which their sheep and horses died of cold; Chai Shao met them in the open, defeated them and entered the city. What ended the stalemate was not the siege engines but a collapse from within: the cousin on his father's side, Luoren, killed Shidu amid the confusion and surrendered.
data: 可核的數字不多，只能逐一標明把握。時間：起事繫於隋大業十一年（617），兩唐書只說「大業末」罷歸舊里，未記月日；舊書、新書同記「師都自起至滅凡十二歲」，滅於唐貞觀二年（628），倒推起事當在617年，本篇以該年夏月記事，確切月日付闕。兵眾：起兵時「陰結徒黨數千人」；野豬嶺之役師都與突厥兵，舊書作「數千騎」，新書作「千騎」，兩說並存，本篇不強取其一。戰果：段德操一戰逐北二百餘里，俘男女二百餘口；數月後再戰，俘斬略盡——這是兩唐書唯一留下的具體數目。援軍：頗利可汗以勁兵萬騎救西城，是史籍中最大的一筆兵力數；武德六年（623）師都部將賀遂、索周以所部十二州降唐，可見其一度控制的州郡數目。距離：夏州朔方郡城（今陝西靖邊）至延州（今陝西延安）約三百餘里，野豬嶺在延州以北的山地；朔方至京師長安逾千里，糧秣輸送全靠沿途屯田與州縣轉運，軍令與援軍到得的遲滯，兩唐書都曾提及。氣候：貞觀二年冬，援軍遇大雪，羊馬大量凍斃，是本役最關鍵的一次天氣因素。器械：師都的攻城器械與唐軍的投石、撞車數目皆無記載，本篇不列。至於雙方兵員、糧秣與斬獲的總數，史料完全空白，任何精確數字都只能出於想像。
dataEn: Few figures are verifiable, and each has to be qualified. Timing: the rising is tied to the eleventh year of Daye, 617; both Tang histories say only that he was dismissed and returned to his old home at the end of Daye, without giving a month or a day. Both the Old and the New History of the Tang record that from his rising to his destruction twelve years passed, and he was destroyed in the second year of Zhenguan, 628, which puts the rising in 617; this account therefore dates it to a summer month of that year, and the exact month is left open. Numbers of men: when he rose he had quietly gathered several thousand followers. At the fight on the Wild Boar Ridge the Old History gives several thousand riders in his and the Turkic army, the New History a thousand, and since the two differ both are given here without choosing between them. Results: Duan Deco's one battle drove the enemy more than two hundred li and took some two hundred persons captive; a few months later a second battle left them cut up almost to the last, and these are the only concrete figures the two histories preserve. Relief forces: Jieli Khagan came to the western city with ten thousand picked riders, the largest single body of men recorded in the sources; in the sixth year of Wude, 623, Shidu's commanders He Sui and Su Zhou surrendered with the twelve districts they held, which shows how many prefectures he controlled at one time. Distances: from the city of Shuofang in Xia Prefecture, now Jingbian in Shaanxi, to Yan Prefecture, now Yan'an, is a little over three hundred li, and the Wild Boar Ridge lies in the hills north of Yan'an; from Shuofang to the capital at Chang'an is more than a thousand li, and grain moved only by the garrison farms and the county depots along the route, which goes some way to explain the slowness of orders and of relief recorded in both histories. Weather: in the winter of the second year of Zhenguan the relief army met a heavy snow and lost a great many sheep and horses to the cold, and this was the single most consequential turn in the weather of the campaign. Machines: neither the number of Shidu's siege engines nor of the Tang stone-throwers and rams is recorded, and none is given here. As for the totals of men, grain and casualties on both sides, the record is simply blank, and any exact number could only be invention.
cause: 起事的原因，是隋朝在西北邊郡的崩解從一個人的落職開始。梁師都是夏州朔方的郡豪，本郡大族，仕隋鷹揚郎將，掌的是邊軍武職；大業年間他罷歸田里，而此時朔方一帶的處境已在崩壞：連年征高句麗與洛陽、運河的役使把丁口與糧運抽空，邊郡屯田的收成被官府搜刮，地方豪族手上的私兵與實力反而上升。隋廷的崩解提供了最後的機會。617年二月李淵起兵太原，同年薛舉據關中、竇建德起於河北，隋煬帝遠在江都，命令出不了洛陽，各邊郡的守將自求生存，誰也不肯為一個失援的郡丞出死力——郡丞唐宗被殺時，郡兵沒有抵抗的機制，朔方城在數千名徒黨的夜襲下失守。梁師都接下來打出的牌是名分與外援：先以「大丞相」聚眾，這是隋朝邊鎮的正式職名，鄉里聽得懂、也肯跟；再以「殺唐宗、報隋仇」為號召，把邊郡的不滿引成兵源；最後靠北連突厥取得馬匹、弓矢與騎兵，把自己嵌進草原與農耕之間既有的交易網。始畢可汗樂見其成，授他狼頭纛與大度毗伽可汗的名號，說明雙方從一開始就是互相利用的關係。師都打敗隋將張世隆、略定三郡之後，力量急劇膨脹，遂不再滿足於一個大丞相，而要自立為帝，於是有了梁國與永隆的年號。制度、役使、糧運與邊防同時出問題，才是這場起事真正的成因；梁師都只是把早已裂開的縫撕大。
causeEn: The cause of this rising lay in the collapse of the Sui in the northwestern border districts, and it began with one man's dismissal. Liang Shidu was a great family of Shuofang in Xia Prefecture, of a local clan that had held that rank for generations, and had served the Sui as a Langjiang of the Yingyang office, a post in the frontier army. During the Daye years he was dismissed and went home, and by then the situation in the Shuofang area was already breaking down: the repeated campaigns against Goguryeo and the great works at Luoyang and on the canal had drawn away the labour and the transport, the harvest of the border garrison farms was being squeezed by the court, and the private troops of the local great families stood higher than ever. The disintegration of the Sui government provided the last opening. In the second month of 617 Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan; in the same year Xue Ju held the passes of Guanzhong and Dou Jiande rose in Hebei, while the Sui emperor was far away at Jiangdu, orders no longer left Luoyang, and the commanders of the border districts each looked after themselves: none of them would risk his neck for a district governor who had lost his support. When Tang Zong was killed there was no mechanism left by which the county troops could resist, and Shuofang fell to a night attack by several thousand followers. The cards Liang Shidu then played were legitimacy and foreign support. He rallied men first under the title of Grand Chancellor, a real Sui office in the border towns, a word the countryside understood and was willing to follow; then he made the killing of Tang Zong and the avenging of the Sui into a summons, turning the resentment of the border districts into soldiers; and finally, by linking himself to the north with the Turks, he obtained horses, bows and cavalry, inserting himself into the existing trading network between steppe and farmland. Qimin Khagan was glad to see it succeed: the wolf-head standard and the title of Grand Tudu Biga Khagan that he sent were the price of a partnership in which both sides used the other from the first day. Once Shidu had beaten Zhang Shilong and taken the three districts his strength grew quickly, and he no longer wanted to be merely a Grand Chancellor: he wanted to be emperor, and hence the state of Liang and the era Yonglong. Institutions, forced labour, transport and frontier defence had all failed at once, and that was the real cause of the rising. Liang Shidu did nothing more than tear open a seam that had already split.
impact: 這場起事對隋唐兩個王朝的邊政，影響比它的戰鬥規模大得多。對隋朝而言，朔方郡的失守等於西北防線被洞穿：隋室在江都風雨飄搖之際，已經沒有多餘的兵力和糧食去補這個洞，北方邊鎮於是各自為政，隋朝最後崩解時，整個西北邊防是敞開的。對唐朝而言，梁師都是建國之後北方最頑固的一處割據，而且他不是孤立的：劉武周在並州、竇建德在河北、王世充在洛陽，四方各有地盤，彼此曾商議合兵。武德二年唐廷先打劉武周，到621年劉武周覆亡，師都才失去屏障，也才開始放手向突厥借力；從621到628年，唐廷用七年處理這最後一處北方割據，期間關中與河東多次用兵，邊州不得安寧。最終平定之後，唐朝取得夏州之地，把朔方一帶重新置於官軍直接控制之下，這是唐在西北建立軍鎮支點的開始，此後安北都護府與靈州防線的經營都以此為基礎；更上層看，消滅師都切斷了突厥在關內的內應管道，唐朝從此可以把主力轉向突厥汗國本身，貞觀四年滅東突厥便是順著這條路走過去的。戰術層面上，這七年的困局也把唐廷對付邊郡叛軍的辦法定型：書諭招撫、生口縱還反間、輕騎反覆踐稼斷糧、歸附者善遇，最後以合兵進逼迫使內部自行崩解；這套手段不靠大軍主力，不靠攻城器械，靠的是耐心與對敵我關係的精細操作。對後世而言，夏州之名一路沿用到明清，成為西北最要的一個地名；唐初在夏州的安置方式，也影響了此後邊州羈縻與屯田並行的體制。師都自己的失敗則留下一個教訓：多疑而誅降附者，使自己人在最要緊的時候不肯再為他出戰——朔方城不是被唐軍攻破的，是被他從父弟的一劍斬開的。
impactEn: The effect of this rising on the frontier policy of both the Sui and the Tang was far larger than the scale of the fighting. For the Sui, the loss of Shuofang commandery was a hole driven through the northwestern line: with the court in Jiangdu and the empire in upheaval there were no troops and no grain left to plug it, the border districts of the north went their own ways, and when the Sui finally collapsed the whole northwestern frontier stood open. For the Tang, Liang Shidu was the most stubborn of the separatist regimes after the dynasty was founded, and he was not alone in it: Liu Wuzhou held Bing Prefecture, Dou Jiande held Hebei, Wang Shichong held Luoyang, and these had their own territories and discussed a joint campaign among themselves. In the second year of Wude the court struck at Liu Wuzhou first, and only when Liu was destroyed in 621 did Shidu lose his shield and begin openly to borrow strength from the Turks. Between 621 and 628 the court spent seven years on this last northern separatist, fighting repeatedly in the passes and on the middle river, and the border districts had no rest. When it was finally settled the Tang took the land of Xia Prefecture and put Shuofang once more under direct official control, which was the beginning of the Tang military foothold in the northwest, the basis on which the Anbei Protectorate and the line of Lingzhou were later organised. On a larger scale, the destruction of Shidu cut the channel by which the Turks had their agents inside the passes, and from that point the Tang could turn its main effort against the khaganate itself, as it did in the fourth year of Zhenguan when Eastern Turkia was destroyed. At the level of method, these seven years fixed the way the court would deal with revolts in the border districts: persuade by letter, send prisoners home as agents, ride light cavalry over the crops again and again to cut the grain, treat those who surrender well, and then bring up the combined columns so that the enemy broke up from within. None of it required a great army or siege engines; it required patience and careful handling of the relations between ruler and ruled. For later ages, the name Xia Prefecture ran on down into the Ming and the Qing as one of the most important place names of the northwest, and the way the early Tang settled the district shaped the later system in which chieftaincies and garrison farms stood side by side in the border prefectures. Shidu's own defeat left a lesson: a jealous man who kills those who come in to him will find, at the worst moment, that his own people will not fight for him again. Shuofang was not taken by Tang assault; it was opened by one stroke of a sword from his cousin on his father's side.
result: 貞觀二年（628）冬，形勢終於收緊。劉旻、劉蘭的勁卒已直據朔方東城，柴紹與薛萬均合兵進屯城下，頗利可汗的萬騎援軍在雪中羊馬死盡，被柴紹逆擊破之，援兵不成，圍城與斷糧同時壓到極點；此時城中已饑虛，部將多懷二心，名將辛獠兒、李正寶曾謀執師都，事洩之後人心益散。城破並非出自正面攻擊：師都的從父弟梁洛仁在亂中斬了梁師都，帶著他出降柴紹。洛仁因此授右驍衛將軍，封朔方郡公；師都自617年舉事到628年覆亡，凡十二年，所據之地改置夏州，部眾或降或散，隨各州縣編入版籍，器械與馬匹盡為官軍所得。回頭看，這一役的關鍵從來不是某一場會戰。起事靠的是襲取郡城與突厥外援，兩樣都是隋末邊郡真空的副產品；官軍第一次得手靠的是段德操「按甲挫銳、輕騎乘懈」的耐心與果斷，第二次得手靠的是把戰爭拖成持久消耗，用反間與斷糧逼出內部的叛離，而最後一劍是由師都自己人落下的。對唐廷而言，平定梁師都標誌著北方割據的最後一處被清乾淨：劉武周、王世充、竇建德、劉黑闥、輔公祏相繼覆亡之後，北方的地盤與邊防的線頭都已歸唐，剩下的是正面對抗突厥的問題；史書記此役僅數百字，兵數、糧秣、器械損耗皆無一筆可考，但可以確定的結果是：隋末北方最後一個自立的政權，在唐太宗貞觀二年冬天被平掉，改為夏州，重新編入唐朝的邊防體系。
resultEn: In the winter of the second year of Zhenguan, 628, the noose finally tightened. The picked troops of Liu Min and Liu Lan already held the eastern city of Shuofang; Chai Shao and Xue Wanjun had joined forces and camped below the walls; and the ten thousand riders of Jieli Khagan, met by deep snow in which their sheep and horses died to the last, were met in the open by Chai Shao and defeated, so that the relief failed and the siege and the cutting of the grain closed on the city together. The city was by then hollow with hunger, the commanders were divided in their loyalty, and the famous generals Xin Liaor and Li Zhengbao had already plotted to seize Shidu himself; when that plot was uncovered the mind of the garrison broke further. The city did not fall by a frontal assault: amid the confusion Liang Luoren, the cousin on Shidu's father's side, cut Liang Shidu down and came out to surrender to Chai Shao. Luoren was granted the rank of Right Cavalry Guard General and the title of Duke of Shuofang. From the rising of 617 to the fall of 628 Shidu had lasted twelve years; the land he had held was reorganised as Xia Prefecture, his followers either surrendered or scattered and were enrolled in the registers of the several prefectures, and his weapons and horses went to the government troops. Looking back, the hinge of this campaign was never any single battle. The rising rested on taking the district city by surprise and on Turkish support, and both were products of the vacuum in the border districts at the end of the Sui. The government's first success rested on the patience and the decisiveness of Duan Deco, who kept his men under arms to dull the enemy's edge and struck with the light cavalry the moment that edge had slackened; the second rested on turning the war into a long attrition, using agents and a cut of the grain to force a breach of loyalty inside. The last stroke was dealt by one of Shidu's own. For the court, the pacification of Liang Shidu marked the clearing of the last of the northern separatisms: after Liu Wuzhou, Wang Shichong, Dou Jiande, Liu Heitao and Fu Gongshi had fallen in turn, the ground of the north and the loose ends of the frontier were all Tang's, and what remained was the business of confronting the Turks head on. The histories give this campaign only a few hundred characters: the numbers of men, of grain and of machines lost are not recorded at all. But the result is certain. The last independent regime in the north of the late Sui was put down in the winter of the second year of Zhenguan by Emperor Taizong of Tang, converted into Xia Prefecture, and taken back into the frontier establishment of the dynasty.
